notes: Maintenance release: CR audit FX-window (#1001). Rules behavior changes: after a paid interrupt on a subroutine's damage (Feedback Filter or Caldera on Tithe or Neural Katana; the Corp's Tori Hanzō), the run goes on: no stale priority frame is left for the subroutine step (CR 9.2.4d, 9.2.9). After a damage or tag interrupt window inside a run step closes, the run goes on from that step instead of resolving it again, so Data Raven's and Funhouse's encounter ability is asked once, with Decoy used or only installed (CR 9.12.3d, 9.11.4f, 9.11.4g). A tag window resumes the paused reaction window as a damage window does (CR 9.2.8a, 9.2.8d), and the run walk stops for a later subroutine's tag window (CR 9.2.9). Cards pin unchanged (v1.147.26).
